changelog: Removed the Compose settings overlay completely. An extension View cannot be inserted into the host Compose Column; putting it beside that column was the source of the detached card, clipping and wrong positioning.

On hosts with the new native PluginSettingsEntryHost registry, CSM is rendered by CloudStream itself directly below Extensions and above the build information. It uses the same TextPreferenceWidget styling and a 32dp CSM icon.
On older Compose hosts, CSM intentionally uses CloudStream's existing native plugin settings action under Extensions instead of rendering an overlay. Legacy XML settings remain supported.
CSM now reports host-native or host-plugin-action in its diagnostic state; it never reports an injected Compose row.
